rationale: Price at $13.84 is still above the 5m 9-EMA ($13.74) and well above VWAP ($13.15), sitting at 90% of today's range, so the gap-down-reversal long structure that justified entry remains technically intact and the pullback from $14.01 is within normal noise (MFE 0% simply means the breakout trigger never fired).
